testing.addon-testcase: Downgraded, not disabled: it stays visible in every report.
Statamic\Testing\AddonTestCase cannot boot this addon. Its setUp() calls
Nav::shouldReceive('build'), which swaps the Nav facade for a strict Mockery mock; this
addon's bootAddon() then calls Nav::extend() and the mock throws
expectations were specified. Reproduced against statamic/cms v6.26.0 with a probe test
before this entry was written, at src/ServiceProvider.php:132 via :83. AddonTestCase also
never invokes bootAddon() itself, so the hand-rolled call in tests/TestCase.php would have
The bed it would replace is not incidental. It runs the identical suite against real MySQL
via DB_DRIVER=mysql (phpunit.mysql.xml) — which caught a 276-character title on its first
run — turns on SQLite's foreign-key pragma so the cascade from events to event_occurrences
is actually enforced, pins app.timezone to a zone no test uses so a missing UTC conversion
cannot hide, and stubs Statamic's licensing Outpost so the suite does not need the network.
Moving to AddonTestCase means rebuilding all of that.
Worth revisiting when core stops mocking Nav in AddonTestCase::setUp().
ui.page-width: `max-w-5xl 3xl:max-w-6xl mx-auto` with `data-max-width-wrapper` is core's own narrow-page
variant for detail screens — pages/forms/Show.vue:61, pages/preferences/Edit.vue:14,
pages/utilities/Licensing.vue:19 — and it is documented as such in
standards/ui-vocabulary.md §2.3. The wrapper carries `data-max-width-wrapper`, so the
header's full-width toggle still applies. The listing page uses max-w-page.
The rule reads `max-w-` literally and cannot tell the two variants apart.

Nothing here is a reason to silence it.
